events.text: Partnership supports accelerated development: NAVIGATE-2 Phase 2 trial is enrolling, with initial data expected in the first half of 2027; a global Phase 3 trial is anticipated to initiate in 2027, pending regulatory feedback About IgA Nephropathy (IgAN) IgA nephropathy (IgAN) is a progressive autoimmune kidney disease characterized by proteinuria, hematuria, and loss of kidney function.
The Company is enrolling patients with IgAN in its ongoing NAVIGATE-2 Phase 2 trial intended to support the Q12W dosing regimen and remains on track to report initial data in the first half of 2027.
